title: Cross-Functional Onboarding Playbook for Lateral Hires
author: Marisol Vega
body:
Overview:

Purpose: This playbook defines a repeatable, measurable onboarding process tailored to "lateral hires" — candidates joining Redwood Inference with prior industry experience (senior ICs, managers, and product/ops leaders) who are expected to ramp quickly across one or more functional boundaries. The goal is to accelerate contribution while preserving role clarity, cross-team alignment, and long-term retention.

Scope: Applies to all lateral hires joining engineering, product, SRE, and platform functions. Excludes entry-level/new-grad onboarding and reorganizations where a current employee changes roles.

Principles: 
- Role-first ramp: clarify scope and success metrics before day one.
- Cross-functional pairing: early structured touchpoints with adjacent teams to reduce integration debt.
- Measurable milestones: 20/60/90 goals tied to manager and peer-reviewed evidence.
- Asynchronous documentation + synchronous alignment: use written artifacts for context and scheduled live syncs for open questions.

Who should use this doc:
- Recruiting and Hiring Managers (pre-offer preparation)
- People Ops and Onboarding Coordinators (preboarding logistics)
- Hiring Managers and Skip-levels (day-to-day ramp supervision)
- Buddies/mentors assigned to lateral hires

Quick-start checklist (pre-boarding, day 0, day 1–30, ongoing):

Pre-Offer (Hiring Manager / Recruiting):
1) Draft a Role Acceptance Packet with:
   - One-sentence role summary (what problem you solve)
   - Top 3 outcomes expected at 90 days
   - Critical cross-team dependencies (names/services/owners)
2) Confirm relocation/visa needs and timeline with People Ops.
3) Agree on the "20/60/90" success metrics and deliverables.
4) Identify buddy (peer in adjacent team) and calendar 1:1s for first 30 days.

Pre-boarding (People Ops / IT, 1–7 days before start):
- Provision accounts: GitHub, Jira, internal docs, Slack, Okta, calendar.
- Ship welcome kit and hardware; include seat/office access instructions if on-site.
- Share Role Acceptance Packet and 20/60/90 goals with hire and manager.
- Create first-week schedule: orientation, team kickoff, and two cross-team introductions.

Day 0–7 (On-site or remote first week):
- Orientation: benefits, payroll, security, code of conduct (People Ops).
- Manager 1:1: confirm first 30-day priorities and communication norms.
- Buddy sessions: 30–60 minute walkthroughs of day-to-day tools and patterns.
- Quick wins: assign a low-risk, high-value task that touches production or docs.

0–30 Days (Ramp foundations):
- Deliverables: complete the quick win, write a runbook or design note for the first area touched.
- Meetings: weekly manager 1:1, two cross-functional syncs, onboarding retro at day 30.
- Evidence of progress: merged PR, test coverage, or customer/partner feedback.

30–60 Days (Cross-functional integration):
- Deliverables: owner of a small feature or stabilization initiative; present a 15-minute walkthrough to related teams.
- Meetings: biweekly stakeholder demos; alignment meeting with product/infra owners.
- Evidence of progress: metrics showing improved latency/cost/throughput for an assigned surface or documented process that reduced onboarding friction.

60–90 Days (Autonomy & impact):
- Deliverables: lead a canary or small rollout, or complete a cross-team integration.
- Manager review: 60-day checkpoint and 90-day performance calibration with skip-level.
- Evidence of success: stakeholder sign-off, quantifiable impact, and a captured 90-day retrospective.

- Leading indicators (behavioral signals):
- Cross-team dependencies (owner + contact):
- Backstop and escalation path:

Manager Responsibilities (checklist):
- Before start: align 20/60/90 outcomes, pick buddy, schedule 1:1s.
- Week 1: clear owner for first quick-win, ensure access is working, and confirm mentor cadence.
- Ongoing: weekly 1:1s, timely feedback after code reviews/demos, escalate blockers to relevant leads.
- Evaluation: conduct 60-day and 90-day reviews with documented evidence and next-step plan.

Buddy / Mentor Checklist (peer):
- Provide guided walkthroughs for: repo layout, CI, alerting, deployment process, and common troubleshooting steps.
- Join first three incident/ops calls as observer and do a post-mortem walkthrough.
- Host 1:1 availability windows in week 1 and week 3.

Hiring Process adjustments for lateral hires (Recruiting / Hiring Manager):
- Interview loop: include at least one cross-functional interview (e.g., product for engineering hires, infra for product hires) to validate collaboration fit.
- Sample task: prefer system-design/contextual questions over small algorithmic puzzles; evaluate communication artifacts (design notes, RFCs) when available.
- Offer packet: include Role Clarity Template and proposed 20/60/90 plan in the offer to set expectations.

Feedback & Performance Integration:
- Use existing 1:1 cadence and performance calibration cycles. Lateral hires require explicit evidentiary inputs for early calibration:
  - Code/PR reviews, demo recordings, stakeholder testimonials, and merged documentation.
- Feedback frequency: managers should provide written feedback after the initial quick win and after the 30- and 60-day demos.
- Calibration: include lateral hires in the next quarterly calibration cycle and flag them for early check-ins in the People Ops dashboard.

20/60/90 Example (Senior Backend Engineer):
- 20-day: onboard, merge a production-sidecar config change, and document the deployment steps.
- 60-day: own a minor feature and ship a canary with rollback plan.
- 90-day: improve a performance metric by 10% or reduce mean time to deploy by documented steps.

Operational templates and artifacts (links to be used in base templates):
- Role Clarity Template (copyable)
- 20/60/90 goal template (spreadsheet)
- New hire access checklist (IT)
- Buddy assignment form
- First 30-day onboarding retrospective template

Escalation & Risk Mitigation:
- Common risk signals: failed access, repeated blocker >3 days, unclear role expectations, poor cross-team feedback.
- Primary escalation path: Manager -> Team Lead -> People Ops -> Head of Function.
- If hiring manager leaves within 90 days: appoint interim manager and re-run Role Clarity review within 7 days.

Evaluation & Continuous Improvement:
- Metrics People Ops tracks for lateral hires: time-to-first-merge, 30/60/90 milestone completion rate, new-hire NPS, and retention at 6 & 12 months.
- Quarterly review: People Ops will sample lateral hires and present findings to leadership with recommended adjustments to the playbook.

Appendix A — Sample Week 1 schedule (remote):
- Day 1 AM: orientation (People Ops).
- Day 1 PM: manager 1:1 + team kickoff.
- Day 2: buddy walkthroughs (repo, CI, ops).
- Day 3: stakeholder intro + cross-team sync.
- Day 4: quick-win assignment kickoff.
- Day 5: retrospective and plan for next 30 days.

Appendix B — Example communication templates:
- Email to cross-team stakeholders introducing the hire (subject line, intro paragraph, expectations).
- Slack intro template for team and product channels.

- Review cadence: annual or after major process incidents (whichever is sooner).
